prompt: A 3x2 GRID of SIX separate circular achievement medallions for a pirate fishing game, evenly spaced, each medallion its own self-contained round emblem, all six drawn in one consistent style. Soft painterly watercolour storybook illustration, warm hand-painted gouache feel, gentle soft-edged brushwork, subtle paper grain, no harsh outlines, no cel shading. Each medallion is a filled circular disc with a raised decorative rim (aged gold, brass or carved timber) and a single clearly readable subject centred inside it, painted as a small scene on the disc face. Palette: aged gold, warm brass, oiled timber brown, bone cream, with deep sea-teal and soft indigo as the cool accent. The set theme is a ship's CREW HALL, a below-decks bunkhouse where the crew are trained, so the deepest bunk glows sea-teal in several of them. IMPORTANT: the background BEHIND and BETWEEN all six medallions is a completely FLAT PURE MAGENTA field, RGB 255,0,255, absolutely uniform, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no checkerboard, no drop shadows onto it. Each medallion must be fully separated from its neighbours by magenta on all sides. TOP-LEFT: a tall cutaway bunkhouse tower of six stacked timber berths lit by hanging lanterns, the lowest berth glowing bright sea-teal, warm gold light in the others. TOP-CENTRE: a drill mallet crossed over a fat stacked provisions barrel bound in brass hoops, both polished and full, ropes coiled beneath. TOP-RIGHT: a thick brass plate with a single deep teal gemstone set into it, the metal around the gem cut and scored deep as if carved far below the others. BOTTOM-LEFT: a ring of ten small round brass rank-pips arranged in a circle on dark oiled wood, every one of them filled and lit warm gold, none empty. BOTTOM-CENTRE: a single upturned open palm rendered as a carved gold sigil, cradling three radiant gemstones, one crimson, one teal, one gold, all three blazing at full brightness with a white-gold halo behind the hand. BOTTOM-RIGHT: six radiant teal-white gemstones arranged in a choir ring around a dark still centre, each throwing soft light onto the ones beside it, deep indigo behind them. No lettering, no numbers, no words, no runes that read as text anywhere in the image.
